name.zh: Pachypteris 厚羽片保存叶器官

description.en: Give the pinnules shallow volume and rounded polygonal tips; preserve frond branching rather than inventing a shrub.
description.zh: 赋予小羽片浅体积和圆钝多边形尖端，保留叶轴分枝，不臆造灌木。

author: Leon Made This / s010s

sources.title: Pachypteris

reconstruction_notes.en: Fossil-specimen foliage only: original branching rachis and thick entire-margined pinnules with shallow lenticular volume and blunt polygonal tips. Nominal0.22m organ span, conservative thickness, simplified veins and muted fossil palette are art choices, not original leaf color or new fossil measurements. Museum genus/specimen text consulted for basic foliage architecture; no exact named specimen replica, whole mother shrub/tree, roots, reproductive organ or newly associated habitat claimed. Original empty biome array retained; no prior frond mesh copied or simply thickened.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 仅化石保存叶器官：原创分枝叶轴与厚全缘小羽片，具浅透镜状体积及钝多边叶尖。0.22米名义器官跨度、保守厚度、细脉简化及柔和化石色为美术设定，不是原叶色或新化石测量。博物馆属级/标本文本用于基本叶序依据；不复制具名标本，不推断母灌木/母树、根、生殖器官或新关联生境。保留原始biomes空数组，不复制旧蕨叶网格或仅加厚改名。

claim_scope: Preserved foliage or ovulate-disc specimen concept only; no whole parent shrub/tree, flower, fungus or newly associated organs implied.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
